items.quote: This service allows any developers to retrieve and manage Aircall data with HTTP requests.
items.why: Quote covers HTTP data access only; no phone system, calls, SMS, or webhooks.

items.quote: With Aircall Public API, Authentication can be done through OAuth or Basic Auth.
items.why: Names OAuth and Basic Auth only; no bearer_token or credential details.

items.quote: The `api_id` is the _username_ and the `api_token` is the _password_ for each Public API requests.
items.why: Quote states api_id as username and api_token as password for Basic Auth.

items.quote: It is a requirement to be listed on the Aircall App Marketplace.
items.why: Marketplace listing requirement is one OAuth gate; not the full customer_account gate.

items.quote: If you haven't received them yet, apply to the Tech Partner program.
items.why: Tech Partner application is related gating; does not establish customer_account gate alone.

items.quote: The root endpoint of Aircall Public API is `https://api.aircall.io/v1`.
items.why: Root URL matches the REST endpoint; resources, rate limit, webhooks not covered.

items.quote: This MCP server is NOT built, maintained, or endorsed by Aircall.
items.why: States the server is not Aircall-endorsed, supporting vendor-official False; existence implied.

items.quote: Unofficial MCP server for Aircall by Allo - 73 tools for calls, contacts, SMS, users, teams & AI insights.
items.why: Calls it an unofficial Aircall MCP server, supporting existence and non-official status.
